newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Broadway clarifies stance on repayment.
newsitem.headline: Broadway clarifies stance on repayment.

text.p: Broadway Industries Ltd on Thursday clarified its intentions regarding the current capital repayment and the conditions under which any further repayment would be made.

"In announcing the capital repayment consideration was given to prudential management in respect to capital outflows, recognising future requirements of the group and also to the fact that there was no imminent sale for the remaining subsidiaries at that point of time," the directors said in a statement to the New Zealand Stock Exchange.

"If any further capital repayment is made it will take into account the achievement of a satisfactory sale for both Southern Packaging and H. E. Perry and/or the return to profitability of Mercer Stainless and Southern Packaging."
